entries.anchor: m14/story:ja-m14-the-letter-to-tom/ja:「きってが ありません。おかねも ありません。」
entries.en: "I have no stamp. I have no money either."

entries.anchor: m14/story:ja-m14-the-letter-to-tom/ja:「みせで きってを かいます。」
entries.en: "I'll buy a stamp at the shop."

entries.anchor: m14/story:ja-m14-the-letter-to-tom/ja:「わたしの さいふに ごひゃくえんが あります。」
entries.en: "There is five hundred yen in my wallet."

entries.en: I have a new envelope too.
